source_title: Improved Mean Flows: On the Challenges of Fastforward Generative Models
quote_or_excerpt:
With the remarkable progress of 1-NFE generation, the
use of a tokenizer begins to incur a non-negligible cost at
inference time. While our work focuses on advancing fast-
forward models and is orthogonal to tokenizer design, from
a practical standpoint, reducing or removing the tokenizer is
becoming increasingly valuable.
observation: 作者明确认为tokenizer的推理成本不可忽略，主张应探索更高效的tokenizer或像素空间生成。
